content: **the last gate falls tomorrow.** day gate 3 unlocks the final two rats — and from that moment on, every rat in the warren is up for grabs in your shop. no more gates, no more waiting. all drop in after 06:00 CET.

embeds.title: 🌅 Dawn-Runt — 1/2, cost 4
embeds.description: thrives in the grey light before the city wakes. battle (before noon): hardens the horde's attack (scales ★).

comes alive as the drains go black again, ahead of the next dawn's ride. battle (after noon): hardens the horde's health (scales ★).

a matched pair — Dawn-Runt takes the morning shift, Dusk-Runt clocks in after noon.
